user.title: Connect a BE WAVE hub
user.description:
Works with BE WAVE Smart HUB and the HYBRID control panels (e.g. HYBRID 128 Plus) over the local network — no cloud, no extra bridge.

Home Assistant signs in exactly like the **Be Wave** mobile app and appears there as one more mobile device of the user you enter.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the hub, e.g. `192.168.1.50`. Give the hub a fixed (reserved) address in your router.
data_description.login: The user name you sign in with in the Be Wave app. Device control requires a user with rights to those devices (typically the administrator).
data_description.password: Password of that user. It is stored only in Home Assistant and sent to the hub encrypted.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {host} rejected the stored login — the password was probably changed in the Be Wave app. Enter the current one. Home Assistant keeps its registered device, so no new device slot is used.

data_description.login: The user name you sign in with in the Be Wave app. Device control requires a user with rights to those devices (typically the administrator).
data_description.password: The new password of this user.

reconfigure.title: Change hub address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the hub got a new IP address. Login and the registered device are kept.

data_description.host: New local IP address of the same hub.

pick.title: BE WAVE hubs found
pick.description: These hubs answered on your network. Pick one or enter the address yourself.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the hub. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant is on the same network (TCP port 4200 must be reachable).
error.invalid_auth: The hub rejected the login or password.
error.device_limit: This user has no free mobile-device slot on the hub. In the Be Wave app remove an unused mobile device of this user and try again.

abort.already_configured: This BE WAVE hub is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again — the integration is reloading.
abort.wrong_hub: The hub at this address is a different one (other serial number) than the one configured.

general.title: BE WAVE options
general.description: Choose which protection mode the alarm panel entity arms and disarms.

data_description.mode: Key of the protection mode on the hub. `defau` is the default mode (whole object). You can type the key of another mode configured in the Be Wave app.
data_description.developer_services: Registers `bewave.debug_patch` and `bewave.debug_send` (raw protocol messages). Only for mapping new devices - a wrong message can restart or reset the hub.

zones.title: Wired zones
zones.description: The panel only reports whether a wired zone is violated. Choose what is connected to each zone - Home Assistant then shows it with the right icon and states (e.g. *Detected* / *Clear* for smoke, *Open* / *Closed* for a gate).

end_before_start.message: The window must end after it starts ({range}).

overlapping_windows.message: Time windows of one day overlap.

too_many_windows.message: At most 8 time windows per day.

schedules_not_loaded.message: The schedule list has not arrived from the hub yet - try again in a moment.

hub_rejected.message: The hub did not accept the change.

schedule_in_use.message: The schedule is used by: {heads}. Give them another schedule first.

schedule_not_found.message: No such schedule on the hub.

save_schedule.name: Save heating schedule
save_schedule.description: Creates or edits a heating schedule on the hub (weekly time windows; inside a window a head in Schedule mode heats to its day temperature, outside to the night one). Schedules are shared by all heads.

days.name: Days
days.description: Day number (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday) → list of [start, end] windows in HH:MM, at most 8 a day. See the example.

delete_schedule.name: Delete heating schedule
delete_schedule.description: Deletes a schedule that no head uses.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: ID from the `schedules` attribute of a thermostat.

assign_schedule.name: Assign schedule to head
assign_schedule.description: Gives the head a schedule (empty = none) and optionally switches it to Schedule mode.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: ID from the `schedules` attribute; empty = no schedule.

activate.name: Switch to Schedule mode
activate.description: Also set the preset to Schedule.

debug_patch.name: Send raw patch (developer)
debug_patch.description: Sends one DeviceStateUpdate patch and returns the raw device state before and after. Enable in the integration options.

wait.name: Wait (s)
wait.description: How long to wait for the new state.

debug_send.name: Send raw message (developer)
debug_send.description: Sends a raw plaintext message (hex) on the integration's session and returns the hub's reply fields. Empty hex = save the last raw configuration to bewave_last_raw.json. Enable in the integration options.

save_scene.name: Save scene / routine
save_scene.description: Create or update a scene or routine in the hub (it runs in the hub, also without Home Assistant). Arming, disarming and alarm actions are refused.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Full definition (see the scenes attribute of the Scenes and routines sensor).

delete_scene.name: Delete scene / routine
delete_scene.description: Delete a scene or routine from the hub.

run_scene.name: Run scene
run_scene.description: Start, pause, resume or stop a scene.

zone_types.title: Choose what is connected to wired zones

zones.title: Wired zones
zones.description: Wired zones of the BE WAVE panel have no type yet: {zones}. Choose what is connected to them so they show the right icon and states.

abort.not_loaded: The BE WAVE integration is not loaded - try again when it is running.
